info.title: Stogas Gateway API
info.description: The Stogas Gateway exposes an OpenAI-compatible surface. Authenticate requests with your Stogas API key, and the gateway will relay the request to the configured upstream provider.

servers.description: Gateway origin. Endpoint paths include their API version.

get.description: Returns the active public gateway catalog used for model discovery, aliases, routing, and prices.
Returns an OpenAI-compatible list of catalog model IDs accepted by the gateway.

post.description: Create an OpenAI-compatible chat completion. The gateway resolves the requested model and route through the compiled Stogas catalog, applies deployment facts such as implied service tier, rejects unsupported parameters, and then relays the request to the configured provider.

200.description: Successful completion. Non-streaming requests return JSON; streaming requests return Server-Sent Events.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each `data:` frame contains a chat completion chunk. When a receipt is requested, a `: stogas {...}` comment appears before `data: [DONE]`. SSE clients ignore the comment.

post.description: Create an OpenAI-compatible Responses API response. The gateway resolves the requested model and route through the compiled Stogas catalog, applies deployment facts such as implied service tier, rejects unsupported parameters, and then relays the request to the configured provider.

200.description: Successful response. Non-streaming requests return JSON; streaming requests return Server-Sent Events.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events stream. Each `data:` frame contains a Responses API event. When a receipt is requested, a `: stogas {...}` comment appears before `response.completed` or `response.incomplete`. SSE clients ignore the comment.

post.description: Checks the supplied scoped execution policies without saving or creating a hold. Include organization and key, every applicable folder, grant, role and member, and only the selected credential. Without a decryption key, encrypted plugin sections are reported unchecked. Limits and editing permissions are checked on save.

encryption_keys.description: Customer roots by registered label, canonical unpadded base64url. Supply the roots required by applicable encrypted plugins and eligible encrypted credentials. Accepted over all supported transports. Removed before provider dispatch; never cached or logged.

rule.description: Rule name when the unchecked plugins belong to a conditional rule.

bearerAuth.description: Pass the Stogas API key as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. This is the canonical OpenAI-compatible header.

authorizationHeader.name: Authorization
authorizationHeader.description: Pass the Stogas API key directly as `Authorization: <token>`. The gateway normalizes this to the canonical Bearer authentication path.

apiKeyHeader.name: api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: Catalog-defined authentication alias. The gateway canonicalizes `api-key: <token>` to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

xApiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
xApiKeyHeader.description: Catalog-defined authentication alias. The gateway canonicalizes `x-api-key: <token>` to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

xGoogApiKeyHeader.name: x-goog-api-key
xGoogApiKeyHeader.description: Catalog-defined authentication alias. The gateway canonicalizes `x-goog-api-key: <token>` to `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Metadata.name: Stogas-Metadata
Metadata.description: Set to `v1` for the final Stogas metadata, including a signed request/response content receipt. Omit to leave normal responses unchanged.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request: The request was malformed, missing required fields, or specifying an unavailable model.

error.message: Invalid text completion request: the 'messages' array cannot be empty.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized: The API key provided was missing or invalid.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment Required: Returned when your organization has insufficient credit or a key, grant, or organization spend limit is exhausted. Use error.code to distinguish insufficient_balance from key_spend_limit, grant_spend_limit, and organization_spend_limit.

error.message: Insufficient credit. Add funds to your organization to retry this request.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: The API key is disabled or expired, or a key policy denied the request.

NotFound.description: Not Found: The requested endpoint route does not exist.

error.message: Not Found: The requested endpoint '/v1/chat/compl' does not exist.

Conflict.description: Conflict: The gateway request ID was already finalized, expired, or reused with different hold parameters. Generate a new request ID and retry.

error.message: Request already finalized; generate a new requestId

PayloadTooLarge.description: Payload Too Large: The decoded JSON request body exceeds 128 MiB.

error.message: Decompressed request body exceeds max allowed size of 134217728 bytes

RateLimited.description: Rate Limited: An applicable platform, organization, grant, or API-key request bucket does not currently have capacity for another request.

InternalError.description: Internal Server Error: An unexpected error occurred within the gateway or upstream provider.

CatalogUnavailable.description: Internal Server Error: The gateway catalog is not available.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service Unavailable: The gateway could not reach the billing database while placing the authorization hold. The provider is not called and no usage telemetry is written.

RequestRoutingPolicy.description: Optional, at most 16 KiB. Requires saved delegation.request permission. Intersects saved policies and is never forwarded upstream. Forbidden policies return 403 and invalid permitted policies return 400.

query.description: Bounded source query. Sorting requires filter_and_sort permission.

allowedCatalogNodes.description: At most 64 IDs in total. Empty lists deny all candidates.

graph.description: Active catalog: authors, groups, models, deployments, routes, and providers. Groups describe model organization and do not supply execution facts.

archive.description: Digest and exact byte length of the separate retired catalog at /catalog/blobs/sha256/{sha256}.json on an evidence origin. Verify both before merging it with this public catalog.

id.description: Model ID or alias accepted by the gateway.

code.description: A code for handling a specific error in your app. May be absent or null when only a broad error type is available. Do not match message text.

param.description: The request field related to the error, when known.

oneOf.description: Known provider ID or provider slug, such as `openai`, `open-ai`, or `anthropic`.
oneOf.title: Provider ID

only.description: Provider IDs or provider slugs allowed to serve this request.

order.description: Preferred provider order after the optional `only` filter is applied.

oneOf.description: Stogas-owned provider routing rules. At least one of `only` or `order` is required.
oneOf.title: Provider constraints

ProviderRoutingPreference.description: Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible chat request fields parsed by the Stogas HTTP API. Unknown top-level fields are accepted for SDK compatibility, ignored, and never forwarded upstream.

model.description: Optional catalog model or deployment slug, optionally provider-qualified. Omit to select among compatible deployments using saved routing restrictions and sorting. If multiple models match without a routing sort order, the request returns model_ambiguous. An explicit selector always narrows the candidates; empty or null selectors are invalid.

provider.description: Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

rules.description: Alias for `provider`. Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

messages.description: Non-empty conversation. Assistant function calls must be followed immediately by one tool result for every call ID in the same stateless request.

frequency_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Chat Completions frequency penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

logit_bias.description: OpenAI-only token bias map. Values must be numbers because the gateway decodes the request into the OpenAI-compatible schema; provider-owned key semantics are left upstream. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

logprobs.description: OpenAI-only Chat Completions log probability output. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

max_tokens.description: Legacy maximum completion token field. Zero is only accepted for Anthropic cache prewarm requests that include an allowed cache_control marker.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum completion token cap. Zero is only accepted for Anthropic cache prewarm requests that include an allowed cache_control marker.

metadata.description: Application metadata for Stogas telemetry only. Stogas validates this object, logs it internally, and removes it before upstream dispatch.

modalities.description: Text-only MVP: when present, this must be exactly ["text"]. Image and audio modalities are rejected before upstream dispatch.

n.description: Number of choices to generate. Stogas currently accepts only omitted or `1`; larger values are rejected before upstream dispatch.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may call multiple tools in parallel.

prediction.description: Predicted output content used by compatible OpenAI models to reduce latency.

presence_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Chat Completions presence penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

prompt_cache_key.description: OpenAI and Azure prompt cache key. Must be non-empty UTF-8 up to 256 bytes and must not contain NUL, CR, or LF. Anthropic deployments reject this field; use `cache_control` instead.

prompt_cache_retention.description: Legacy OpenAI retention control for models before GPT-5.6, and Azure retention policy. GPT-5.6 OpenAI requests should use `prompt_cache_options.ttl`; current Azure GPT-5.6 deployments accept only `24h`.

prompt_cache_options.description: OpenAI GPT-5.6 prompt caching mode. `implicit` keeps the provider-managed breakpoint; `explicit` writes only marked prompt blocks. OpenAI tracks at most four active breakpoints and reports cache writes as one input-token partition.

cache_control.description: Anthropic-only prompt caching control. Stogas accepts `{type:"ephemeral"}` with optional `ttl:"5m"` or `"1h"`, validates explicit cache controls on text content/tool blocks, and prices cache writes conservatively for holds.

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration for models that expose reasoning controls.

enabled.description: OpenRouter-compatible binary control. On a deployment with effort levels, true selects the nearest level to medium.

effort.description: Canonical Stogas effort. Unsupported positive values map to the nearest deployment level, with upward ties; `none` is rejected when reasoning cannot be disabled.

max_tokens.description: Maximum reasoning-token budget. The selected deployment supplies the exact inclusive minimum and maximum.

response_format.description: Provider-owned output format constraint. Stogas forwards supported OpenAI-compatible fields and leaves provider-specific format details to the selected upstream provider.

seed.description: Best-effort deterministic sampling seed for providers that support it.

service_tier.description: Provider service tier. Availability and normalization depend on the selected deployment; see [Compatibility Notes](/docs/reference/provider-behavior#service-tiers).

stream_options.description: Additional options for streamed Chat Completions. Requires `stream:true`. Stogas accepts `include_usage` and always forces it to `true`; `include_obfuscation` is not supported on Chat Completions.

stop.description: OpenAI-compatible stop sequence or stop sequence array. Stogas validates JSON shape and normalizes the string shorthand to an array before upstream dispatch; provider-owned value limits are left to the selected provider.

stop_sequences.description: Anthropic-only stop sequence alias. Stogas rejects this field on OpenAI deployments and rejects requests that set both `stop` and `stop_sequences`.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Stogas validates JSON shape and preserves the value; provider-owned bounds, combinations, and model support are left to the selected provider.

tool_choice.description: Tool choice. Chat Completions accepts `auto`, `none`, `required`, or an exact `{type:"function",function:{name}}` selector for a declared function.

tools.description: At most 128 exact function definitions. Chat custom and hosted tools are not accepted because their calls cannot be replayed losslessly through the provider-neutral stateless Chat history shape. Remote MCP tools are not accepted because provider execution cannot be bounded or approved per request.

top_logprobs.description: Provider-owned OpenAI Chat Completions log probability detail.

top_k.description: Anthropic-only sampling control. Rejected for OpenAI deployments.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling control. Stogas validates JSON shape and preserves the value; provider-owned bounds, combinations, and model support are left to the selected provider.

safety_identifier.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility and removed before dispatch. Stogas sets upstream safety identity from the authenticated API key.

user.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility and removed before dispatch. Stogas sets upstream user identity from the authenticated API key.

verbosity.description: Text verbosity preference for models that support it.

encryption_keys.description: Customer roots by registered label, canonical unpadded base64url. Supply the roots required by applicable encrypted plugins and eligible encrypted credentials. Accepted over all supported transports. Removed before provider dispatch; never cached or logged.

object.description: The object type, which is always "chat.completion"

message.content: You can never fully trust code you did not write yourself.

ChatMessage.description: Exact Chat history item. Tool call IDs must be unique and every assistant call must have one adjacent tool result. Native attachments require a user message and a compatible deployment.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call ID for tool response messages.

refusal.description: Assistant refusal text when provided by the model.

reasoning.description: Reasoning output when returned by the provider.

reasoning_details.description: Signed Anthropic-format reasoning history. Rejected on OpenAI-format and Chutes deployments.

finish_reason.description: Reason why the model stopped generating

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the completion

ChatMessageContent.description: Message content as either a string or an array of content blocks.

index.description: When present, this must match the call's array position.

arguments.description: A string that encodes a JSON object.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls made by the assistant

ChatContentBlock.description: Text-only chat content block accepted by Stogas.

cache_control.description: Anthropic prompt-cache control for this text block.

ResponsesRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible Responses API request fields parsed by the Stogas HTTP API. Unknown top-level fields are accepted for SDK compatibility, ignored, and never forwarded upstream.

model.description: Optional catalog model or deployment slug, optionally provider-qualified. Omit to select among compatible deployments using saved routing restrictions and sorting. If multiple models match without a routing sort order, the request returns model_ambiguous. An explicit selector always narrows the candidates; empty or null selectors are invalid.

provider.description: Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

rules.description: Alias for `provider`. Optional Stogas-owned routing preference used to select a provider when a public model slug is available from more than one provider. This field is never forwarded upstream.

input.description: A non-empty string or exact stateless input-item array. Client function/custom calls require one matching output in the same array before another message.

include.description: Additional OpenAI Responses fields to request. Values are provider-owned and not enum-mirrored by Stogas; Anthropic-backed deployments reject this OpenAI-only field.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output token cap. Zero is only accepted for Anthropic cache prewarm requests that include an allowed cache_control marker.

max_tool_calls.description: Optional cap for priced hosted Responses tools. If omitted for a priced hosted tool, Stogas injects an effective cap of 50 before dispatch. Anthropic translates this cap to hosted-tool max_uses; function-only and custom-only requests must omit it.

metadata.description: Application metadata for Stogas telemetry only. Stogas validates this object, logs it internally, and removes it before upstream dispatch.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may call multiple tools in parallel.

prompt_cache_key.description: OpenAI and Azure prompt cache key. Must be non-empty UTF-8 up to 256 bytes and must not contain NUL, CR, or LF. Anthropic deployments reject this field; use `cache_control` instead.

prompt_cache_retention.description: Legacy OpenAI retention control for models before GPT-5.6, and Azure retention policy. GPT-5.6 OpenAI requests should use `prompt_cache_options.ttl`; current Azure GPT-5.6 deployments accept only `24h`.

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration for models that expose reasoning controls.

effort.description: Canonical Stogas effort. Unsupported positive values map to the nearest deployment level, with upward ties; `none` is rejected when reasoning cannot be disabled.

max_tokens.description: Maximum reasoning-token budget. The selected deployment supplies the exact inclusive minimum and maximum.

service_tier.description: Provider service tier. Availability and normalization depend on the selected deployment; see [Compatibility Notes](/docs/reference/provider-behavior#service-tiers).

stream_options.description: Additional options for streamed Responses. Requires `stream:true`. Stogas accepts `include_obfuscation`; `include_usage` is server-owned and rejected on this route.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Stogas validates JSON shape and preserves the value; provider-owned bounds, combinations, and model support are left to the selected provider.

frequency_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Responses frequency penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

presence_penalty.description: OpenAI-only Responses presence penalty. Anthropic deployments reject this field.

text.description: Text output configuration, including structured output format and verbosity.

format.description: Provider-owned Responses text format. Stogas forwards supported OpenAI-compatible fields and leaves provider-specific format details to the selected upstream provider.

top_logprobs.description: Provider-owned Responses log probability detail. Anthropic deployments reject this OpenAI-only field.

top_k.description: Anthropic-only sampling control passed through the explicit Stogas allowlist. Rejected for OpenAI deployments.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling control. Stogas validates JSON shape and preserves the value; provider-owned bounds, combinations, and model support are left to the selected provider.

tool_choice.description: Exact tool choice. OpenAI-format deployments accept `auto`, `none`, `required`, named function/custom selectors, exact declared hosted selectors, or `{type:"allowed_tools",mode:"auto"|"required",tools:[...]}`. Anthropic-format deployments accept only the string modes or a named function selector.

tools.description: At most 128 exact Responses tool definitions. Stogas admits function tools, custom tools on OpenAI-format deployments, known and priced OpenAI/Anthropic web-search versions, and known Anthropic `web_fetch` versions. Unknown future versions fail closed instead of inheriting current pricing. Remote MCP tools are rejected because provider execution cannot be bounded or approved per request and third-party servers are outside the cataloged data-handling boundary. See the Model Tools guide for the current provider matrix and billing behavior.

safety_identifier.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility and removed before dispatch. Stogas sets upstream safety identity from the authenticated API key.

user.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility and removed before dispatch. Stogas sets upstream user identity from the authenticated API key.

prompt_cache_options.description: OpenAI GPT-5.6 prompt caching mode. `implicit` keeps the provider-managed breakpoint; `explicit` writes only marked prompt blocks. OpenAI tracks at most four active breakpoints and reports cache writes as one input-token partition.

stop_sequences.description: Anthropic-only stop sequence alias passed through the explicit Stogas allowlist. Stogas rejects this field on OpenAI deployments. Responses does not admit top-level `stop`; Chat rejects requests that set both `stop` and `stop_sequences`.

cache_control.description: Anthropic-only prompt caching control. Stogas accepts `{type:"ephemeral"}` with optional `ttl:"5m"` or `"1h"`, validates explicit cache controls on input content/tool blocks, and prices cache writes conservatively for holds.

encryption_keys.description: Customer roots by registered label, canonical unpadded base64url. Supply the roots required by applicable encrypted plugins and eligible encrypted credentials. Accepted over all supported transports. Removed before provider dispatch; never cached or logged.

object.description: The object type, which is always `response`.

output_text.description: Convenience concatenation of output text content when available.

ResponsesInputItem.description: Responses API output item returned by the supported text, client-tool, reasoning, web-search, and web-fetch paths.

output.description: Tool output payload for function_call_output and related output items.

ResponsesMessageContent.description: Responses message content as either a string or an array of content blocks.

ResponsesRequestInputItem.description: Exact stateless Responses input item. Function and custom calls require one matching output in the same array. Custom history is OpenAI-format only; encrypted reasoning history is OpenAI reasoning-deployment only. Native attachments require a user message and a compatible deployment.

arguments.description: Function arguments encoded as a JSON object string.

ResponsesRequestMessageContent.description: Message text or supported content blocks. Native attachments require a user message.

AnthropicTaskBudget.description: Advisory agent-loop budget for direct Anthropic Opus 4.7+, Fable 5, and Mythos 5 deployments. Azure Claude and other models reject it. This value does not reduce the Stogas billing hold; remaining must not exceed total.

AnthropicContextManagement.description: Strict Anthropic-wire context editing. Edit types must be unique, and clear_thinking_20251015 must be first when present. compact_20260112 is accepted only for Fable 5, Mythos 5 or Preview, Opus 4.6 through 5, and Sonnet 4.6 or 5 deployments, including matching Azure Claude deployments. Compaction does not reduce the billing hold; Stogas reserves a possible compaction sampling step before every bounded model sampling iteration and settles the sum of provider usage.iterations.

PromptTokenDetails.description: Provider-reported input-token partitions. `cached_tokens` is the OpenAI-compatible cache-read field and `cache_write_tokens` is the OpenAI-compatible cache-write field.

created_at.description: Gateway-reported request time; not an independent freshness proof.

ttft_ms.description: Gateway-observed time from request start until the first generated token-bearing streaming payload is accepted for sending. It includes Stogas processing, retries, and provider time. It is omitted for non-streaming responses and streams without generated output.

provider.description: Useful upstream facts selected by the provider adapter, covered by the same receipt signature.

usd.description: Canonical exact USD, with at most 36 fractional digits.

rateUsd.description: Canonical exact USD, with at most 36 fractional digits.

upstream_cost_usd.description: Canonical exact USD, with at most 36 fractional digits.

billed_cost_usd.description: Canonical exact USD, with at most 36 fractional digits.

cache_read_savings_usd.description: Canonical exact USD, with at most 36 fractional digits.

cache_write_overhead_usd.description: Canonical exact USD, with at most 36 fractional digits.

StogasMetadata.description: Optional final response metadata. One receipt signature covers the exact request and response hashes and the RFC 8785 canonical metadata object with its top-level receipt removed.
